sources.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP): Security Design Considerations for AI-Driven Automation

clauses.NSA-SUPPORTED: Choose supported MCP projects; strict code audit; enrol via registry
clauses.NSA-BOUNDARIES: Design for trust boundaries; caution with dynamic tool discovery; classification zones; egress proxy/DLP
clauses.NSA-PARAMS: Validate parameters against schemas, ranges and context
clauses.NSA-SANDBOX: Constrain and sandbox tool execution; least privilege; deny unneeded fs/network
clauses.NSA-SIGN: Sign and verify messages; time-bound signatures; replay protection
clauses.NSA-OUTPUT: Filter and monitor outputs; length checks; rate limiting; detect indirect injection
clauses.NSA-LOGGING: Log all invocations with identities; integrate with SIEM; detect anomalies
clauses.NSA-PATCH: Track and patch MCP vulnerabilities; maintain inventory of deployed tools
clauses.NSA-SCAN: Scan networks for unauthorised or vulnerable MCP servers

sources.title: Careful adoption of agentic AI services
sources.publisher: ASD ACSC, CISA, NSA, Cyber Centre, NCSC-NZ, NCSC-UK

clauses.FVEY-IDENTITY: Distinct cryptographic identity per agent; trusted registry; least-privilege roles
clauses.FVEY-DEFENCE-IN-DEPTH: Overlapping controls; secure every input and output point
clauses.FVEY-THIRD-PARTY: Trusted current components; approved tool allow list; SBOMs; separation of duties
clauses.FVEY-RESILIENCE: Fail-safe defaults, data loss prevention, rollback
clauses.FVEY-SECURE-DEFAULT: Fail safe; escalate to humans when uncertain; degrade gracefully
clauses.FVEY-ISOLATION: Segment agents; separate high-risk agents; restrict log write access
clauses.FVEY-MONITORING: Monitor all operations; detect drift; human and automated review
clauses.FVEY-HITL: Require human approval for high-impact actions
clauses.FVEY-PRIVILEGES: Least privilege; short-lived credentials; signing and attestation; runtime policy checks
